name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single hard Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) matches 'Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down' — pot_boiling is a lasting condition and stove_fixed, a one-step event that happens while the pot is still boiling, closes it each time. No goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
